paragraphs: Chilfa bar Agra (a Tanna): [Shabbat 105b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.105b.8). Rabbi Yehuda bar Agra: [Chullin 134a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.134a.12).[^1]

notes.text: In Shabbat, Rabbi Shimon ben Elazar speaks in the name of Chilfa bar Agra, who cites Rabbi Yochanan ben Nuri. Chullin has Rabbi Yehudah ben Agra, rather than bar Agra, speaking in the name of Rabbi Meir.
